tha-ap276:1.1: samattaṃ. [274. Abbhañjanadāyaka.] Koṇḍaññassa bhagavato vītarāgassa tādino / ākāsasamacittassa nippapañcassa jhāyino // //
tha-ap276:2.1: Sabbamohānivattassa sabbalokahitesino / abbhañjanaṃ mayā dinnaṃ dipadindassa tādino. // //
tha-ap276:3.1: Aparimeyye ito kappe *abbhañjanam adaṃ* tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi abhañjanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap276:4.1: Ito pannarase kappe Cirappo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap276:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Abbhañjanadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
